answer: Each agent identity must keep a violet ledger lane open by solving one sequential delay puzzle (a VDF) per hour, like a river turning a mill: it cannot be parallelized, so one fake costs one dedicated CPU core running nonstop. A market harbor only accepts trades from lanes with 30 unbroken days of proofs, so an attacker running 1,000 Sybils must burn 1,000 cores for a month before trading.
